name: Professional Ethics in Chemical Engineering
description: Ethical foundations (moral autonomy, professional boundaries) and applied frameworks (utilitarian cost-benefit analysis, deontological safety rules). AIChE code of ethics and global regulations (registration, evaluation, authorization and restriction of chemicals (REACH) / environmental protection agency (EPA)), HAZOP-style case studies involving ethical problem-solving. Risk management (layers of protection analysis (LOPA), fault trees) and accident forensics (Bhopal, Texas city investigations). Engineers’ environmental/social duties (plastic waste ethics, community impacts) and emerging challenges (AI bias in process control, carbon capture dilemmas).
